feat(J3): record cohort provenance and separate replay evidence tiers

J3 executes P1-D18 under P1-F38/P1-F39. J0 reported 8/30 normalized,
12/30 final-byte and 0/30 trajectory agreement but carried no provenance, so
none of those numbers could be traced to a tier, a source identity or a
missing observation. This commit adds that record without rerunning J0.

Scope is reprojection only: no provider, host, detector or model ran. The 2802
raw result files, the 147 frozen/registered files and PREREGISTRATION.md keep
their original bytes; the audit compares against Git blobs at 7754ee2 rather
than trusting file existence.

Changes:
- harness/provenance.py emits one manifest per cohort/pass (11 total, 233
  retained runs). Every observation carries value/status/source/scope, so a
  reader can tell a checked fact from an unverified one and from a fact that
  does not exist. Redacted requests keep model/seed/temperature/top_p/
  max_tokens/stream plus HTTP outcome; no token, header, prompt, tool argument
  or response body is copied.
- harness/replay.py extracts the original normal/trajectory comparisons into
  shared code and adds two columns: final_source_bytes (path set plus UTF-8
  bytes) and raw_verdict_bytes (artifact bytes, unmatched paths counted
  separately). The old fields and their per-pair values are preserved.
- REPLAY.md and CLAIMS.md state the tier of every number. Fixed scripted replay
  is local observed stability; same-harness model replay is partial internal
  replication; independent replication is unavailable at n=0 and is never
  substituted by the first two.
- harness/cohort.mjs captures start/finish manifests for future authorized
  cohorts and refuses admission when archive, dependency, runtime, host source
  or material identity has drifted. The registered runner is unchanged so the
  historical validation chain stays intact.

Verified independently of the audit script:
- 70 replay rows unchanged in count; L3 stays 8/30, 12/30, 0/30; fixed stays
  40/40 and 24/24 raw verdicts. No historical number moved.
- 2802 raw files and 147 frozen files byte-identical to HEAD; no diff under
  results/raw, frozen/ or PREREGISTRATION.md.
- Provenance regenerates byte-identically: 11 manifest hashes match index.json
  after a clean re-run, and 18 generated files are stable across regeneration.
- 12 synthetic fixture checks pass (harness/check-j3.py); no model or judge ran.

Two dependency-cache drifts are recorded rather than repaired: Cheers
node_modules/.vitest/results.json and NormProof node_modules/.vite/vitest/
.../results.json changed after J0 froze its inventory, both written by test runs
today. They stay unverified and block any determinism promotion.

seed acceptance remains unverified; independent replication, trusted billing,
cost and provider backend identity remain unavailable. Cheers packaged build
artifact is unavailable, so the CLI artifact claim is withheld. Nothing here
supports a product, platform, release-readiness or intervention-efficacy claim.
